verses.original: עוּרִ֥י עוּרִ֛י לִבְשִׁ֥י עֻזֵּ֖ךְ צִיּ֑וֹן לִבְשִׁ֣י׀ בִּגְדֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ עִ֣יר כִּ֣י עָרֵ֥ל וְטָמֵֽא׃ לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֛יף ע֖וֹד יָבֹא־ בָ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rî ‘ū·rî liḇ·šî ‘uz·zêḵ ṣî·yō·wn liḇ·šî biḡ·ḏê ṯip̄·’ar·têḵ yə·rū·šā·lim haq·qō·ḏeš ‘îr kî ‘ā·rêl wə·ṭā·mê lō yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ yā·ḇō- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Awake awake clothe yourself with strength O Zion Put on your garments of splendor O Jerusalem holy city For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer . . . enter you

verses.original: הִתְנַעֲרִ֧י מֵעָפָ֛ר ק֥וּמִי שְּׁבִ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִתְפַּתְּחוּ מוֹסְרֵ֣י צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ שְׁבִיָּ֖ה בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·na·‘ă·rî mê·‘ā·p̄ār qū·mî šə·ḇî yə·rū·šā·lim hiṯ·pat·tə·ḥū mō·ws·rê ṣaw·wā·rêḵ šə·ḇî·yāh baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Shake off your dust Rise up [and] sit [on your throne] O Jerusalem Remove the chains from your neck O captive Daughter of Zion

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֑ם חִנָּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א בְכֶ֖סֶף תִּגָּאֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar nim·kar·tem ḥin·nām wə·lō ḇə·ḵe·sep̄ tig·gā·’ê·lū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says You were sold for nothing and without money you will be redeemed

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ בָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה עַמִּ֥י יָֽרַד־ מִצְרַ֛יִם לָג֣וּר שָׁ֑ם וְאַשּׁ֖וּר עֲשָׁקֽוֹ׃ בְּאֶ֥פֶס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ḇā·ri·šō·nāh ‘am·mî yā·raḏ- miṣ·ra·yim lā·ḡūr šām wə·’aš·šūr ‘ă·šā·qōw bə·’e·p̄es
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says At first My people went down to Egypt to live . . . then Assyria oppressed them without cause

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה מִי־ לִי פֹה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ עַמִּ֖י לֻקַּ֥ח חִנָּ֑ם מֹשְׁלוֹ יְהֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה שְׁמִ֥י מִנֹּאָֽץ׃ וְתָמִ֥יד כָּל־ הַיּ֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mī- lī p̄ōh nə·’um- Yah·weh kî- ‘am·mî luq·qaḥ ḥin·nām mō·šə·lō yə·hê·lî·lū nə·’um- Yah·weh šə·mî min·nō·’āṣ wə·ṯā·mîḏ kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: And now what have I here declares the LORD For My people have been taken without cause those who rule them taunt declares the LORD and My name [is] blasphemed continually all day long . . .

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן עַמִּ֖י יֵדַ֥ע שְׁמִ֑י לָכֵן֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם כִּֽי־ אֲנִי־ ה֥וּא הַֽמְדַבֵּ֖ר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ‘am·mî yê·ḏa‘ šə·mî lā·ḵên ha·hū bay·yō·wm kî- ’ă·nî- hū ham·ḏab·bêr hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: Therefore My people will know My name therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks Here I am

verses.original: מַה־ נָּאו֨וּ עַל־ הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֣י מְבַשֵּׂ֗ר מַשְׁמִ֧יעַ שָׁל֛וֹם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר ט֖וֹב מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ יְשׁוּעָ֑ה אֹמֵ֥ר לְצִיּ֖וֹן אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃ מָלַ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: mah- nā·wū ‘al- he·hā·rîm raḡ·lê mə·ḇaś·śêr maš·mî·a‘ šā·lō·wm mə·ḇaś·śêr ṭō·wḇ maš·mî·a‘ yə·šū·‘āh ’ō·mêr lə·ṣî·yō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ mā·laḵ
verses.literal: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news who proclaim peace who bring good tidings who proclaim salvation who say to Zion Your God reigns

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צֹפַ֛יִךְ נָ֥שְׂאוּ ק֖וֹל יַחְדָּ֣ו יְרַנֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֣י עַ֤יִן בְּעַ֙יִן֙ יִרְא֔וּ יְהוָ֖ה בְּשׁ֥וּב צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ṣō·p̄a·yiḵ nā·śə·’ū qō·wl yaḥ·dāw yə·ran·nê·nū kî ‘a·yin bə·‘a·yin yir·’ū Yah·weh bə·šūḇ ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Listen Your watchmen lift up their voices together they shout for joy For every eye . . . will see when the LORD returns to Zion

verses.original: פִּצְח֤וּ רַנְּנוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו חָרְב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ נִחַ֤ם עַמּ֔וֹ גָּאַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: piṣ·ḥū ran·nə·nū yaḥ·dāw ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim kî- Yah·weh ni·ḥam ‘am·mōw gā·’al yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Break forth in joy sing together O ruins of Jerusalem for the LORD has comforted His people He has redeemed Jerusalem

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ חָשַׂ֤ף קָדְשׁ֔וֹ זְר֣וֹעַ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֖ת וְרָאוּ֙ יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- ḥā·śap̄ qā·ḏə·šōw zə·rō·w·a‘ lə·‘ê·nê kāl- hag·gō·w·yim kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ ’êṯ wə·rā·’ū yə·šū·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: The LORD - has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations all the ends of the earth - will see the salvation of our God

verses.original: ס֤וּרוּ ס֙וּרוּ֙ צְא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם תִּגָּ֑עוּ אַל־ טָמֵ֖א צְא֣וּ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ הִבָּ֕רוּ נֹשְׂאֵ֖י כְּלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: sū·rū sū·rū ṣə·’ū miš·šām tig·gā·‘ū ’al- ṭā·mê ṣə·’ū mit·tō·w·ḵāh hib·bā·rū nō·śə·’ê kə·lê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Depart depart go out from there Touch no unclean thing come out from it purify yourselves you who carry the vessels of the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א תֵּצֵ֔אוּ בְחִפָּזוֹן֙ לֹ֣א וּבִמְנוּסָ֖ה תֵלֵכ֑וּן כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס וּמְאַסִּפְכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî lō tê·ṣê·’ū ḇə·ḥip·pā·zō·wn lō ū·ḇim·nū·sāh ṯê·lê·ḵūn kî- Yah·weh hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·ḵem ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ū·mə·’as·sip̄·ḵem
verses.literal: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste for the LORD goes before you and the God of Israel is your rear guard

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה עַבְדִּ֑י יַשְׂכִּ֖יל יָר֧וּם וְנִשָּׂ֛א מְאֹֽד׃ וְגָבַ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘aḇ·dî yaś·kîl yā·rūm wə·niś·śā mə·’ōḏ wə·ḡā·ḇah
verses.literal: Behold My Servant will prosper He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר רַבִּ֔ים כֵּן־ שָׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ מַרְאֵ֑הוּ מִשְׁחַ֥ת מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְתֹאֲר֖וֹ מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer rab·bîm kên- šā·mə·mū ‘ā·le·ḵā mar·’ê·hū miš·ḥaṯ mê·’îš wə·ṯō·’ă·rōw mib·bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Just as many . . . were appalled at Him His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man and His form [was marred] beyond human likeness . . .

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן יַזֶּה֙ רַבִּ֔ים גּוֹיִ֣ם מְלָכִ֖ים יִקְפְּצ֥וּ פִּיהֶ֑ם עָלָ֛יו כִּ֠י רָא֔וּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ סֻפַּ֤ר לָהֶם֙ הִתְבּוֹנָֽנוּ׃ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ
verses.transliteration: kên yaz·zeh rab·bîm gō·w·yim mə·lā·ḵîm yiq·pə·ṣū pî·hem ‘ā·lāw kî rā·’ū ’ă·šer lō- sup·par lā·hem hiṯ·bō·w·nā·nū wa·’ă·šer lō- šā·mə·‘ū
verses.literal: so He will sprinkle many nations Kings will shut their mouths because of Him For they will see what they have not been told and they will understand what they have not heard
